Pedal Power Sunday Beginner Ride

Middletown, CT · Road · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Pedal Power Sunday Beginner Ride is a road and social group ride in Middletown, CT. It rolls every Sunday at 2:00 pm from Rotating (check ride page each week). Pace: beginner. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 2:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pedal Power Sunday Beginner Ride group ride

A Sunday afternoon ride for people new to riding in a group. Start point rotates around central Connecticut; the shop posts the week's location on its ride page. Easy pace, everyone regroups.
